newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sun Fook Kong jumps on injection hopes.
newsitem.headline: Sun Fook Kong jumps on injection hopes.

text.p: Sun Fook Kong Holdings Ltd's share price doubled on hopes of future asset injections after China Travel International Investment Hong Kong Ltd agreed to buy a controlling stake in the company, brokers said.

"Anticipation of possible asset injection by China Travel boosted price sky-high," said a sales manager at regional brokerage. "It is hard to predict how far it will surge when the rally is no longer dictated by fundamentals but by anticipation."
Sun Fook Kong shares jumped HK$1.98 or 103.13 percent to HK$3.90 in late Wednesday morning. Volume was 218.90 million shares worth HK$708.30 million.

China Travel said earlier this week that it had agreed to buy a 51.66 percent stake in Sun Fook Kong for HK$466.39 million and it would make a cash offer for the remaining Sun Fook Kong shares at HK$1.08 each.
